seasonal_note: Seasonal workers may use their average over the preceding six months. Our source describes this for income; whether hours can be averaged too is not confirmed, so Kept averages income only.

proof_by_activity.work: Pay stubs. The state may also check wage data automatically.
proof_by_activity.gig: Earnings statements or screenshots from the app showing dates, time worked and pay. Montana lists tax returns for self-employment, so keep monthly records as backup.
proof_by_activity.cash: A note or pay record from the employer with dates and hours. Kept's daily log helps here.
proof_by_activity.self_employment: Business records or tax returns, depending on the state.
proof_by_activity.volunteer: A signed statement from the organization showing your hours each month.
proof_by_activity.education: School schedule or transcript showing credit hours.
proof_by_activity.work_program: Work program participation form signed by the program.

postpartum.label: postpartum (up to 12 months after giving birth)

caregiver_child.label: parent or caregiver of a child under 14

caregiver_disabled.label: caregiver of a person with a disability

tribal.label: American Indian or Alaska Native
tribal.proof: Self-declaration form, tribal enrollment number, or IHS documentation

veteran_total_disability.label: veteran with a total (100%) disability rating
veteran_total_disability.proof: Statement from the VA showing the rating

medically_frail.label: medically frail (a serious condition that makes 80 hours hard)
medically_frail.proof: Self-declaration form for new applicants, or a provider attestation

treatment.label: in a drug or alcohol treatment program

snap_tanf_work.label: already meeting SNAP or TANF work rules
snap_tanf_work.proof: Usually checked by the state automatically

released_incarceration.label: released from jail or prison in the last 3 months

hospital_stay.label: short-term hardship: hospital or inpatient stay
